name: mobile-app-builder
description: A mobile app agency for iOS and Android

interface.longDescription: An organized mobile app agency with eight departments, sixteen specialist roles and 189 workflows. Coordinate Apple App Store and Google Play intelligence, TikTok/Instagram/YouTube creator research, TikTok/Meta/Google ad intelligence and website SEO through verified public Apify Actor routes, alongside product strategy, UI/UX, Expo development, QA/security and store assets. Portable role cards work sequentially; native agents depend on host support. Credentials, authorized paid runs and account operations stay in the user environment. This package guides local work and does not host execution or submit apps.
capabilities: Coordinate research, design, development and QA
Plan Apify CLI research with traceable evidence
Prepare screenshots, metadata, release and growth
defaultPrompt: Plan my Expo app for iOS and Android: scope, architecture, risks, and proof.
Build or audit one Expo feature with loading, empty, error, offline, accessibility, and platform checks.
Plan app growth with store intelligence, ASO, SEO, creators, ad research, activation, retention, and measurement.

publication.release_notes: Source-only publisher checks and a bounded prepared-catalog browser; preserves 189 workflows and 16 roles.
